description: Source code for a Ublox 6M GPS hardware UART driver, including GPS data handling, threading, and initialization functions.

methods.name: getCurrentSpeed
methods.description: Returns the current GPS speed from GPSdata.

methods.name: printGpsInfo
methods.description: Prints GPS information such as port names, message counts, vehicle speed, and location.

methods.name: onGpsMessage
methods.description: Processes a new GPS message buffer, updates GPS data and time.

methods.name: isGpsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if GPS RX and TX pins are configured.

methods.name: initGps
methods.description: Initializes GPS hardware, configures pins, starts serial communication, and creates GPS thread.
